svg.text: ORBIT-3D System Architecture: Five-Stage Closed-Loop 3D Quantum-Chemical Generation
Decoupled Architecture: orbit3d/generator (Stages 1–4) | orbit3d/oracles (Pluggable Modes A–D) | orbit3d/physics (DPA-4 ZBL & HyFF Charge/Spin)
LAYER 1 (orbit3d/generator) — Stages 1–3: Bidirectional Interval-Conditioned Uni-3DAR Octree Transformer
• Leaf Token tau_i = (octant_path_i, z_i in A, q_x, q_y, q_z)
• Deterministic Valence Mask: sum_j b_ij <= v_max(z_i) (100% Closed-Shell)
• Explicit Charge Q & Spin M=2S+1 Input
Unified Oracle Bus: Mean mu_k(M), Epistemic Uncertainty sigma_k(M), Grad d(y_k)/dX
LAYER 2B (orbit3d/physics) — Dual-Engine OMol25 Quantum Force Fields
• 5 Built-in Scales: Nano (1.95M), Mini (2.62M), Neo (4.42M), Air (19.9M), Plus (34.0M)
• Dense SE(3)-Equivariant SO(2) Message Passing across 83 Elements (incl. 5d Ir)
• Analytical ZBL Short-Range Nuclear Repulsion Bridge: Z_i Z_j / r_ij * phi_ZBL(r_ij)
• 93.8% Recovery on Severe 0.65 A Steric Clashes (Zero NaN Divergence)
• Built-in Sweet-Spot Tiers: presto (8.9M), vivace (25.5M), moderato (132.9M); +andante
• Element-Sparse Routing (0.05M–0.83M active/atom) + Fused Triton & CUDA Graphs
• Explicit Total Charge Q in Z & Spin Multiplicity M = 2S+1 (S0, T1, D0+ PES)
• 97.7–113.0 atoms/ms (23.2x Faster, 0.22–1.07 GB VRAM) & Ir(III) dE(T1-S0) r=0.70
Unified Physics Bus: Forces F_MLIP(z, X, Q, M) = -dE/dX & State Energy E(Q, M)
LAYER 3 (Closed-Loop Alignment & Physical Relaxation) — Stage 4 Online Gated-GRPO & Stage 5 Tangent Relaxation
1. Group Rollout & Doubly Gated Interval Reward:
G_unc = exp(-max(0, sigma - tau)/tau), G_phys = exp(-gamma max(0, F_rms - F_th))
L_total = L_GRPO(theta) + beta_KL D_KL(pi_theta || pi_ref) + lambda L_SFT
• Prevents Oracle epistemic reward hacking & high-strain conformations
• Updates Uni-3DAR Policy pi_theta in Closed Loop (Left Feedback Bus)
X_{m+1} = X_m + eta_m * F_m^perp (Zero Interval Violation Drift)
Accepts step iff R_int(X_{m+1}; I) >= R_int(X_m; I)
Supports Black-Box Uni-QSAR & DPA-4 (ZBL) -> HyFF (Q, M) Relay
• Relaxes sub-grid 0.01 A octree discretization artifacts on S0 or T1 PES
• Theorem 1: Monotonic Energy Descent + Exact Interval Preservation
